note: NECO Literature round 2 (Round 18 lift): fresh devices (synecdoche, anaphora, antithesis, pathetic fallacy, pun, paradox), poetry form (enjambment, Petrarchan vs Shakespearean sonnets, free verse, lyric, anaphora), drama and prose terms (hubris, stock character, unities, farce, epistolary, third-person limited, stream of consciousness, unreliable narrator, bildungsroman, falling action), African works new to the bank (Yeats title source, Song of a Goat, Jagua Nana, Piano and Drums, Weep Not Child, Beautyful Ones, Okonkwo) and oral performance detail (opening formula, tortoise trickster, ijala, call-and-response, closing song). Scanned against NECO round 1, the WAEC twin and all banks.
